description: This file defines the IconRepository class, which manages icon-related constants and provides a method to retrieve icon names based on module identifiers in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: IconRepository
classes.description: A class that provides constants for icon labels and a method to retrieve icon names based on module names.

methods.name: getIconName
methods.description: Returns the icon name associated with a given module, defaulting to a normalized version of the module name if not explicitly listed.
